title: Martial Arts Manhwa Artist Seung-nam Ha Dies at 68
content: Born in Busan in 1958, Ha entered the comics industry as an apprentice to artist Nam-gil Heo. He made his debut in 1980 with The King of Baseball Without a Nationality . One of his best-known works, Goltong's Declaration of Departure , began serialization in the newspaper Sports Today in 2001.
